page_title: TOR 1-1 VER | Torino v Verona 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Kevin Bonacina is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
88' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Nikola Vlasic and he is replaced by Karol Linetty (Torino).
87' It will be a substitution. Darko Lazovic (Verona) is ready to enter the pitch as Ondrej Duda walks off.
86' Samuele Ricci (Torino) takes out his opponent with a slide tackle and the referee wastes no time in showing him a red card!
85' Ondrej Duda (Verona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
84' Corner kick. Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
84' The game is interrupted now, Ondrej Duda (Verona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
83' Eljif Elmas (Torino) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Junior Ajayi is coming onto the pitch as Amin Sarr (Verona) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) coming on for Antoine Bernede.
78' Samuele Ricci (Torino) takes a long-range free kick and whips it into the box. The goalkeeper reads it well and leaps high to intercept the ball.
78' A player from Verona pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Torino.
77' Kevin Bonacina blows the whistle, Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) is penalised for a foul.
75' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
71' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Daniel Mosquera is replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
70' It is time for a substitution. Ivan Ilic (Torino) is on for Cesare Casadei.
70' Here's the change. Che Adams leaves the pitch and Antonio Sanabria (Torino) comes on as a substitute.

67' 1 - 1 Eljif Elmas (Torino) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Nikola Vlasic. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the bottom left corner via the post. 1:1!
64' 0 - 1 Goal! Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a huge mistake and Amin Sarr (Verona) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gvidas Gineitis leaves the pitch and Yann Karamoh (Torino) comes on.
62' Che Adams (Torino) fails to convert a penalty kick! His shot is poor and is saved by the goalkeeper.
61' Che Adams (Torino) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
60' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
60' Referee Kevin Bonacina makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
58' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
58' Eljif Elmas (Torino) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
57' A cross into the box picks out Daniel Mosquera (Verona), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.
56' The free kick from long range, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Kevin Bonacina had an easy-decision to make.
53' Amin Sarr (Verona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
51' Eljif Elmas (Torino) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
51' The free kick is taken by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino), but ball is cleared.
50' Eljif Elmas (Torino) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
50' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Torino will take a free kick.
49' A cross from Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Verona comes to nothing.
48' Antoine Bernede (Verona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Verona.
46' Half-time substitution. Paolo Vanoli decided to make a change. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) is replaced by Marcus Pedersen.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The corner from Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is hurriedly cleared.
45' An attempted cross from Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is cleared. Verona have a corner.
44' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) sends a long ball in, but Lorenzo Montipo comfortably gathers the ball.
43' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle after Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
42' The referee blows his whistle as Antoine Bernede (Verona) was too aggressive in his challenge.

40' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
38' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Kevin Bonacina no option but to blow his whistle.
36' That was close. Antoine Bernede (Verona) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
35' Samuele Ricci (Torino) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

33' Antoine Bernede (Verona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Kevin Bonacina blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
32' Amin Sarr (Verona) forces a pass into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
31' Antoine Bernede (Verona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is quickest to intercept the ball.

30' Saul Coco (Torino) attempts to put in the resulting set piece, but he miskicks and sends the ball into the stands. A strong but inaccurate shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
30' Saul Coco (Torino) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
29' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) makes a strong challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul. Torino have a free kick.
28' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) sends a long ball forward to Daniel Mosquera, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
27' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
21' Eljif Elmas (Torino) tested Lorenzo Montipo with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
19' What an opportunity! Che Adams (Torino) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
19' Referee Kevin Bonacina sees the trip by Amin Sarr (Verona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

16' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
16' Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
15' Amin Sarr (Verona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Verona.
10' Torino couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
9' One of the Verona players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Torino have been awarded a free kick.
9' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
9' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
6' One of the Verona players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
4' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Daniel Mosquera (Verona). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
2' The free kick from long range, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Torino keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Torino will kick the game off.
Kevin Bonacina got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
